Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished, large landscape fantasy MOBA champion SPLASH ILLUSTRATION, no text, no labels, no border, no collage, no inset variants. Subject: Serai, Desert Oracle.
Input image role: original character design reference board, NOT an edit target to reproduce as a board. Use ONLY the rightmost figure labeled DESERT ORACLE as the costume reference. Preserve that character's individual face, body type, colors, armor construction, signature weapon and identity. Draw a completely new scene and action pose.
Art direction: the polished painterly quality of a League of Legends champion splash illustration. Expert hand-painted fantasy realism with intentionally sculpted shape language, elegant line of action, mature believable anatomy, intelligent expressive eyes, dramatic perspective and purposeful edge control. Rich material detail concentrated on the face, hands, weapon and principal costume, softer atmospheric brushwork in the surroundings. Large bold readable silhouette at thumbnail scale and exquisite detail when enlarged. More expressive, designed and painterly than the reference's static costume presentation; avoid photographic cosplay or a uniform generative CGI look. Original Warrior League character; no Riot logos and no copied existing champion.
Scene and narrative: Serai calmly parts a vast amber sandstorm in the ruins of a desert astronomical city. Her recognizable double-ring staff suspends a golden sand spiral; turquoise glazed ceramic shoulder and waist armor catches hard reflected light above layered sand-colored silk and a dusty crimson sash. The mature warm brown face and silver-threaded dark curls stay identical to the reference; she looks past the viewer with calm authority. Her free hand guides thin streams of sand into an intricate floating map. Dramatic crimson and ochre environment against cool turquoise character accents, cloth moves with weight and graceful clear shape. Ruined carved arches and distant moon give epic depth, richly painted not photoreal cosplay.
Composition: high-resolution wide landscape, cinematic, the single champion fills about 65-75% of the image height, full figure including feet and most or all signature weapon visible, face large enough to inspect, compelling asymmetric golden-triangle composition and foreground/middle/background separation. Show the character as a complete individual with connected limbs, coherent clothing construction and correct hand anatomy. No added limbs, floating parts, random armor pieces, cropped face, unreadable effects cloud or generic glossy fantasy cover. Use the reference precisely for identity, and invest in the new illustration's visual storytelling and premium painterly finish.
